integrity: All labeled one-, three-, and five-voter profiles are exhausted. Kemeny is cross-checked by pairwise-agreement and Kendall-distance formulations, and the five-voter count is independently replayed by an anonymous-profile multiplicity census and candidate-orbit calculation.
scientific_limitations: The finding is the complete preference-profile census only at the known first odd-electorate Kemeny–Copeland separation. Five-voter minimality and the unique tilted margin shape \((3,1,1)\) are prior; no formula for larger electorates is claimed.
title: Complete five-voter Kemeny–Copeland conflict layer
